text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"The Ocean Stakes... It's a prelude to the 
Kawaii Derby♪"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Aha. Of course, I haven't forgotten, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Still, that reaction of yours, 
Onii-chan... Got me real curious~...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Still, that reaction of yours, 
Onee-chan... Got me real curious~...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Decided~♪ Today, I'm gonna run just for 
you, Onii-chan!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Decided~♪ Today, I'm gonna run just for 
you, Onee-chan!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Because it feels like you've forgotten. 
That Curren—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fired up for the race and longing for the 
brilliant glow of the turf...♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I'll teach them a lesson in today's race♪
